note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 5 June 1924. The Lisburn Standard nomination report (9 May 1924) lists all fifteen divisions: single nominees in eleven, two nominees in Derriaghy, Dunmurry, Glenavy and Magheragall; Derriaghy became uncontested because the second nomination was informal (BNL 10 May 1924), and there were no withdrawals, leaving polls in Dunmurry, Glenavy and Magheragall (LS 16 May 1924 p8). Sole nominee at the close of nominations; the paper lists contests as possible only in Derriaghy, Dunmurry, Glenavy and Magheragall. Returned unopposed.
